column1: # Test-infrastructure input only: these packages provide non-root Xvfb and X11 client libraries
# to native graphics tests. Authenticated offline inputs stage them under online/inputs/xvfb-debs;
# every smoke verifies and extracts them in a network-none container. They are never installed into
# the host, the pinned development image, or a release artifact.
# New XKB pins: publisher checksums at packages.debian.org/bookworm/amd64/{libxcb-xkb1,libxkbcommon-x11-0}/download
# are cross-checked against the exact deb.debian.org pool bytes by isolated acquisition.
